sn12.16:2.1: In _jarāmaraṇassa ce bhikkhu_, _bhikkhu_ can be read as either vocative or nominative. At [sn12.67:9.1]() we find _jarāmaraṇassa ce, āvuso, bhikkhu_, where _āvuso_ is the vocative and _bhikkhu_ is nominative. If _bhikkhu_ was the vocative here, it would result in a repeated _bhikkhu bhikkhu_. I suspect one _bhikkhu_ was dropped in error to avoid this, so translate as nominative.
